object: a squad of interlocking bricks and little bricks shaped like trees
morph: two brick trees peek and hide before they become 林
creativeAngle: 積木小隊玩躲貓貓，兩棵木頭樹拼出林，詞用「樹林」。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 林 (woods). Lead: a team of blue and yellow bricks. Moment 1 (0-1.7s): a green brick tree peeks from the left; the voice says 林; the team turns, the tree vanishes. Moment 2 (1.7-3.4s): a second tree pops from the right, dodging; bricks chase and bump; on the second 林 both trees slide together as 林. Moment 3 (3.4-5.3s): the bricks hide behind the trees but their legs show; as the voice says 樹林 more tiny brick trees pop up around, hiding the whole team like a forest. Moment 4 (5.3-8s): glyph still; one brick pops its head out and waves, then ducks again. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "林、林、樹林" (ㄌㄧㄣˊ、ㄌㄧㄣˊ、ㄕㄨˋ ㄌㄧㄣˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. conceptZh: 披風英雄追著抱走小木樹的布忍者繞圈圈，披風蓋住頭亂衝還勾到第二棵樹，最後飛撲肚子著地，兩棵小木樹「咚咚」並排插直站好，變成林字。
object: two toy wooden trees, each a straight trunk with one horizontal branch bar and two splayed roots; a caped action-figure hero; a tiny felt ninja
morph: the chase ends in a belly-flop; the ninja's stolen tree and the tree snagged in the hero's cape both thump upright side by side, trunk, branch bar and roots reading as two 木 that form 林
creativeAngle: 改用「追逐」而非並排站好的靜態變形：忍者偷樹逃跑、英雄被自己的披風蓋頭亂衝、再勾走第二棵樹，一次飛撲讓兩棵木樹同時插直成林，撞擊本身完成筆畫；煙霧彈在說「樹林」時才爆開，灑下葉子點題，三句語音各有畫面對應。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright 3D cartoon clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 林 (woods). Pale cream background, soft toy-shelf floor, nothing busy behind. Lead: a chunky caped action-figure hero with a shiny red cape three sizes too long. Rival: a tiny felt ninja who thinks he is invisible. Props: two toy wooden trees, each a straight trunk with one horizontal branch bar and two splayed roots.

Moment 1 (0 to 1.5s): On the left the felt ninja "hides" behind one little wooden tree that is smaller than he is, both feet and his round head poking out. On the right the hero plants his feet, points a stiff heroic finger at him and winds up to charge. As the off-screen voice says the first 林, the ninja squeaks, scoops the tree up over his head and zips off.

Moment 2 (1.5 to 3.5s): Big loop-the-loop chase across the frame. The hero sprints, his cape flies up and flops over his face, and he keeps running blind, skidding round a corner with squeaky skid trails. The ninja zigzags past the second toy tree; the hero's trailing cape hooks it and drags it bouncing behind him. He peels the cape off his eyes, sees the ninja, and leaps.

Moment 3 (3.5 to 5s): Freeze one beat in mid-air, cape streaming, then a cartoon belly-flop SPLAT onto the floor with squash and stretch. The ninja tumbles out in front, his tree pops free, and the snagged tree flies off the cape. On the second 林 both trees thump upright side by side in the center of frame, trunk, branch bar and roots snapping into two matching 木 shapes that together read as the single correctly formed glyph 林, saturated forest green, filling about 70% of frame height with clear margins.

Moment 4 (5 to 8s): The glyph stays perfectly still. The ninja scurries behind the left stroke, feet still showing. Exactly as the voice says 樹林, his smoke bomb finally goes off with a soft poof and a shower of tiny green leaves drifts down around the two trees, never covering the strokes. The hero sits up off to the right with a dizzy grin, cape over one eye, gives a wobbly thumbs-up and tips over.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "林、林、樹林" (ㄌㄧㄣˊ、ㄌㄧㄣˊ、ㄕㄨˋ ㄌㄧㄣˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops. No other speech, no music louder than the voice, only gentle cartoon boings and a soft poof. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 林, centered and uncropped, held still for the final 3 seconds. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
